implementation: Windows 10 Home, Pro, Enterprise, Education, October 2018 Update and Windows Server 2019, Windows Server 2019 Datacenter (version 1809); SymCrypt Cryptographic Implementations
description: The Microsoft Windows Next Generation Cryptographic algorithm implementation provides enhanced support for AES, DRBG, DSA, ECDSA, RSA, HMAC, KAS, KDF, SHS (SHA), and Triple-DES. All implementations are packaged into a library used by Microsoft and other third-party applications.
